name: nette/neon
family: NEON (Nette Object Notation), a YAML-like format
reason: NEON, not YAML: Nette documents NEON as its own YAML-like format. Neon::decode rejects both controls (Bad indentation on line 17 of catalog.yaml; Unexpected '-' on line 3 of order.yaml).

name: mustangostang/spyc
reason: Pinned 0.6.3 (4627c838) fails both valid controls through Spyc::YAMLLoadString: double-quoted \u and \t escapes are not decoded, clip-chomped block scalars lose the final line break, '|-' with more-indented lines becomes a nested list, '...' becomes a sequence item, and {} cannot be told from []. See the probe record.

name: grasmash/yaml-expander
family: symfony/yaml (Yaml::parse into PHP arrays) plus placeholder expansion
reason: Mapping layer over the selected symfony/yaml: YamlExpander::parse() calls Yaml::parse() without PARSE_OBJECT_FOR_MAP and then expands ${...} placeholders in the PHP array (laravie/orchestra precedent). It also fails order.yaml: {} comes back as an empty array.

name: grasmash/yaml-cli
family: symfony/yaml via a Symfony Console CLI
reason: CLI-only tool (yaml-cli get:value/update:key ...); the cell protocol excludes CLI-only tools. Its parsing is the selected symfony/yaml.

name: wp-cli/mustangostang-spyc
reason: Spyc fork with the excluded spyc lead's failures: Mustangostang\Spyc::YAMLLoadString leaves \u and \t escapes undecoded and drops the final line break of clip block scalars (catalog.yaml), and turns the '|-' block with more-indented lines into nested lists and '...' into a sequence item (order.yaml).

name: hassankhan/config
family: symfony/yaml (Yaml::parse with PARSE_CONSTANT into PHP arrays)
api_hint: new Noodlehaus\Config(string, new Parser\Yaml, true) then all()
reason: Config loader over the selected symfony/yaml: Parser\Yaml calls Yaml::parse(string, PARSE_CONSTANT) and Config merges the resulting PHP array (mapping layer). catalog.yaml matches; order.yaml fails because {} becomes an empty array.

name: pragmarx/yaml
family: symfony/yaml or ext-yaml via a Laravel config loader
reason: Laravel configuration loader: src/package/Support/SymfonyParser.php and PeclParser.php call symfony/yaml or yaml_parse()/yaml_parse_file() without callbacks and merge the PHP arrays into Laravel config (mapping layer over selected parsers; arrays cannot tell {} from []). Not probed: it requires illuminate/support.

name: jbzoo/data
reason: Data container over the selected symfony/yaml: Yml decodes with Yaml::parse into a PHP array (mapping layer). catalog.yaml matches; order.yaml fails because {} becomes an empty array.

name: aplus/config
reason: Config parser over the selected pecl/yaml: Parsers\YamlParser calls yaml_parse_file() without callbacks and returns the PHP array (mapping layer; {} and [] collapse). Not probed separately.

name: dallgoot/yaml
reason: Pinned 1.0.1 (973c8a64) fails the primary valid control through Yaml::parse(string): \" and \t escapes in double-quoted scalars stay undecoded and the single-quoted '' escape is not reduced. See the probe record.

name: maikuolan/common
family: Maikuolan Common YAML handler (own line parser)
reason: Own line parser that fails both controls: anchors and aliases are kept as the strings '*base' / '&shared', -17 and -2.5 stay strings, clip block scalars lose the final line break, and on order.yaml '---'/'...' become map keys and the flow sequences are misread.

name: xp-forge/yaml
reason: Own parser that fails both controls: it throws 'Illegal escape sequence starting with \u' on catalog.yaml, and returns {} as an empty array on order.yaml.

name: horde/yaml
reason: Own loader that fails both controls: \u and \t escapes stay undecoded, -17 becomes the float -17.0 (catalog.yaml), \n stays undecoded and {} becomes an empty array (order.yaml).

name: mougrim/yaml-cst
reason: Concrete-syntax-tree and patching library over libtree-sitter and tree-sitter-yaml through ext-ffi; it returns CST nodes and mapping-pair indexes, not the document's values (no scalar typing or alias expansion), so it has no documented value-tree API for the typed-tree control. Not probed.

name: secondparty/dipper
reason: Own subset parser that fails both controls: quoted scalars keep their quotes and escapes, anchors/aliases are not supported, and the block-sequence root of order.yaml is misread as a mapping.

name: charcoal-dev/yaml
reason: Own line parser (comely-io/yaml lineage) that fails both controls: a TypeError on catalog.yaml and a flattened, string-valued tree for order.yaml.

name: comely-io/yaml
reason: Own line parser that fails both controls: a TypeError on catalog.yaml and a flattened, string-valued tree for order.yaml.

name: phpalchemy/yaml
reason: Spyc-derived ("maintained version of spyc") and fails both controls with the Spyc escape, block-scalar, alias and '...' errors.

name: mecha-cms/x.y-a-m-l
reason: Mecha CMS extension: its parser registers itself on the CMS From class and does not load standalone, so no documented library API could be run. Not probed.

name: 3rd-party/yaml
reason: Spyc-derived variant of phpalchemy/yaml; fails both controls with the Spyc escape, block-scalar, alias and '...' errors.

name: maxbeckers/php-yaml-parser
reason: Own scan parser; catalog.yaml matches, but the documented parse() returns ArrayObject for both mappings and sequences (parsePlainArray() returns arrays), so {} and [] are indistinguishable and order.yaml fails.

name: gijsbos/yamlspeed
reason: Own parser that fails both controls: \u escapes stay undecoded and the folded scalar loses its line break (catalog.yaml); '---' adds a null item, the alias is null and the flow sequence becomes a mapping (order.yaml).

name: tbela99/yaml
reason: Derivative fork of the selected parser family: both controls match through Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml::parse(PARSE_OBJECT_FOR_MAP), but the package is a comment-preserving fork of symfony/yaml 5.1 that keeps the Symfony namespace; 916 of its 1,164 distinct non-test source lines also occur in symfony/yaml v5.1.0 (560 in the selected v8.1.11). Excluded like the predecessor-version precedents (zend-json, trust-dns-proto), with 15 lifetime downloads.

name: keruald/yaml
reason: Wrapper over the selected symfony/yaml that registers custom tags (Parser::parse calls Symfony's parser). Not probed.

name: scottchiefbaker/yaml-polyfill
reason: Pure-PHP yaml_parse() polyfill that returns false on both controls.
